name: HT Live Polls & Voting
author: Hitesh Tarasariya

sections.description:
HT Live Polls & Voting provides an intuitive, real-time opinion poll and voting engine designed for workplace polls, community feedback, and public surveys.

Key Features

  • Poll UI Design: Modern option box cards with embedded radio selectors, real-time percentages, horizontal progress bars, and total voter count footers.
  • Unique Email Voting: Enforces unique votes per poll based on Email Address (and user ID) to guarantee authentic results.
  • Poll Expiration Datetime: Set expiration date and time for polls to automatically close voting when expired.
  • Bulk Multi-Delete Functionality: Select multiple polls, questions, or vote submissions and delete them simultaneously with AJAX confirmation modals.
  • Comprehensive Shortcodes: Easily embed polls ([live_poll id="123"]), standalone questions ([live_question id="123"]), user login/registration forms, and front-end support ticket forms.
  • Submissions & Analytics: View real-time response distribution graphs and voter submission logs in the WordPress admin dashboard.
  • Theme Overrides: Seamlessly override plugin templates by placing files inside your-theme/ht-live-polls-and-voting/.
  • WordPress.org Compliant: Strict security practices, sanitization, escaping, and nonces.

Shortcodes

  • [live_poll id="123"] – Embeds an opinion poll with option selection, real-time percentage indicators, progress bars, and total voter count.
  • [live_question id="123"] – Embeds a standalone question/poll card.
  • [live_polls_login] – Renders user login form with client-side validation and AJAX authentication.
  • [live_polls_register] – Renders user registration form and triggers welcome emails.
  • [live_polls_forgot_password] – Renders password reset request form.
  • [live_polls_support] – Renders a front-end contact and support ticket submission form.

Template Overrides

To customize poll templates in your active theme:
1. Create a folder named ht-live-polls-and-voting in your active theme’s directory (e.g. wp-content/themes/your-theme/ht-live-polls-and-voting/).
2. Copy wp-content/plugins/ht-live-polls-and-voting/templates/quiz/quiz-card.php or question-card.php into wp-content/themes/your-theme/ht-live-polls-and-voting/.
3. Modify the template as needed!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ht-live-polls-and-voting folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Add the [live_poll id="123"] shortcode to any page or post.
sections.faq:
How is unique voting handled?

Unique votes are checked based on Email Address to prevent voters from submitting multiple responses on the same poll.

Can I view graphical analytics of poll submissions?

Yes! Log into WordPress Admin and go to Polls > Submissions & Analytics to view real-time horizontal distribution bar graphs.
